This is my plot, the one I have grown maize on for many seasons. I am hoping for the FISP coupon this year — last year I got one bag of urea, and I will use it again on this plot if I am lucky, but I must spread it carefully because the plot is small and I have no money to buy more. I keep my own maize seed from last harvest because hybrid seed is too costly without a coupon, and I plant pigeon pea and pumpkin between the maize rows so the soil stays good. I work the plot myself with my children — I cannot pay ganyu workers, I am the one who does ganyu for others when food runs short.
